name: Orchestrator Governance & Software Factory Management
description: Evaluates the performance of Fisca-Lead-Orchestrator in task decomposition, delegation brief precision, strict merge governance, and state handoff maintenance.

criteria.name: Task Delegation & Briefing Quality
criteria.description: Evaluates how effectively the orchestrator breaks down work and creates self-contained, well-structured briefs for specialized agents.
criteria.scoringGuide: 1: Briefs are vague, missing mandatory fields (task_id, target branch, acceptance criteria), or assigned to wrong agents. 2: Briefs provide basic objectives but lack spec references or self-containment, forcing agents to context-seek. 3: Briefs include required fields and correct agent targeting, though acceptance criteria lack precise detail. 4: Briefs are fully self-contained with task_id, specs, detailed acceptance criteria, branch, and correct agent targeting. 5: Briefs are impeccably structured, unambiguous, fully self-contained, and perfectly tailored to the receiving agent's specialization.

criteria.name: Registry & Truth Source Adherence
criteria.description: Measures strict compliance with fisca_contracts_registry and master backlog records without inventing contract names or violating truth sources.
criteria.scoringGuide: 1: Invent technical names not present in fisca_contracts_registry or ignores truth sources completely. 2: Loosely references technical contracts without verifying registry names, causing mismatches. 3: Mostly adheres to registered asset names and backlog state, with minor discrepancies in asset naming. 4: Rigorously verifies fisca_contracts_registry and master backlog before issuing decisions or tasks. 5: Demonstrates flawless alignment with truth sources, ensuring zero unverified technical assets or inaccurate backlog entries.

criteria.name: Merge Governance & Gatekeeping Safety
criteria.description: Assesses strict enforcement of merge policies, QA Auditor score thresholds (>= 95/100), green test checks, and safety guardrails.
criteria.scoringGuide: 1: Merges unvalidated code, attempts force-push/deletion, or bypasses QA auditor validation. 2: Merges code with audit scores below 95/100 or without verifying green test results. 3: Follows basic merge policies but fails to explicitly confirm harness and zero-trust security guardrails. 4: Merges strictly after QA Auditor validation (score >= 95/100, green tests) and respects zero-trust gatekeeper rules. 5: Exemplary gatekeeping: meticulously validates score thresholds, tests, and security guardrails prior to merging, ensuring absolute repository safety.

criteria.name: Session Handoff & State Maintenance
criteria.description: Evaluates the accuracy, granularity, and structure of updates made to FISCA_STATE_AND_HANDOFF at session conclusion.
criteria.scoringGuide: 1: Fails to update FISCA_STATE_AND_HANDOFF or attempts to overwrite the entire document destructively. 2: Updates state document partially or introduces disorganization and unverified task states. 3: Updates FISCA_STATE_AND_HANDOFF cleanly, but updates lack section-by-section precision. 4: Correctly updates FISCA_STATE_AND_HANDOFF section-by-section, accurately detailing completed and pending tasks. 5: Delivers a flawless, highly transparent handoff update that provides seamless continuity and exact operational clarity for subsequent sessions.
